description: The Go server (go-binary, whatever its path). expected: the checks it is known to fail, by client, each with why and the step that removes it. lacks: the operations it does not have yet (OpenAPI operationIds and the inventory's named operations), each with why and the step that adds it; a check that needs one reports target-lacks, and the runner first asks the server that each one really answers 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED_YET (scripts/conformance/README.md, Declared gaps). This is the parity tracker: entries are removed as operations are built. CI fails a pull request that adds an entry, or makes a check newly lack an operation, unless it carries the conformance-regression label.
